notes: EXAMPLE of the CENTRAL register: copy to policy/policy-registration.json in YOUR copy of the kit (it is delivered to every caller by $/ at the kit commit the caller pins, so a change reaches a repository when it moves its pin). Names below are placeholders. Precedence, most specific wins: kit default < enterprise < org < org+team < org+product < org+team+product < repository; a scope with environment_tier ranks above the same scope without one. THE AUTHORITY FLOOR (KDEC-018): the enterprise entry (the orgs map says which orgs it binds) is the floor for every org, and each org's entries the floor for its teams, products and repositories -- a narrower entry may only TIGHTEN; leaving anything weaker is POLICY_BELOW_AUTHORITY_FLOOR (BLOCKED), with or without a decision. ONCE THE orgs MAP DEFINES AN ENTERPRISE, AN ORG IT DOES NOT NAME RUNS AT THE ENTERPRISE FLOOR (KDEC-020): the strictest enterprise when several are defined, with the notice ORG_UNMAPPED_RAN_AT_ENTERPRISE_FLOOR -- add each org to the map so it runs under its own enterprise. Per-finding secret_exceptions are not rung changes. Every entry is a decision; uat/prod departures name the environment's required reviewers. A harness may PROPOSE a register (proposed_by); a person signs it off (sign_off). Validate with: python3 scripts/policy_registration.py --validate <file> --origin central

policies.notes: The top authority's rung: the floor for every org mapped to this enterprise. Raise it to walk and every org, team, product and repository beneath it runs at walk or above.
